posts.text: Inspected the India-Pakistan border at Sir Creek today. Under PM Modi's leadership, 'Smart Borders' and 'Zero Infiltration' remain our non-negotiable security priorities. Never let India's head bow. Salute to our brave BSF jawans guarding the nation.
posts.caption: Inspected the India-Pakistan border at Sir Creek today. Under PM Modi's leadership, 'Smart Borders' and 'Zero Infiltration' remain our non-negotiable security priorities. Never let India's head bow. Salute to our brave BSF jawans guarding the nation.

posts.text: NEET. CBSE. SSC. And today CUET. Four exams. One crore children. Not a single one conducted with honesty. Claims of 'Vishwa Guru' but can't conduct even one exam — Modi ji has completely ruined the entire education system.
posts.caption: NEET. CBSE. SSC. And today CUET. Four exams. One crore children. Not a single one conducted with honesty. Claims of 'Vishwa Guru' but can't conduct even one exam — Modi ji has completely ruined the entire education system.

posts.text: The loss of lives in a tragic accident on the Betwa River in Hamirpur district is extremely heartbreaking and heart-rending. Have directed officials to intensify relief and rescue operations immediately.
posts.caption: The loss of lives in a tragic accident on the Betwa River in Hamirpur district is extremely heartbreaking and heart-rending. Have directed officials to intensify relief and rescue operations immediately.

posts.text: The country needs an educated PM. CUET exam centres across UP are reporting server failures — students who prepared for months can't even start their exams. This government has failed India's youth.
posts.caption: The country needs an educated PM. CUET exam centres across UP are reporting server failures — students who prepared for months can't even start their exams. This government has failed India's youth.

posts.text: Interacted with FM Tsahkna of Estonia and European Commissioner for the Mediterranean Šuica at the Gymnich meeting in Cyprus. Productive exchanges on deepening India-EU cooperation across priority areas.
posts.caption: Interacted with FM Tsahkna of Estonia and European Commissioner for the Mediterranean Šuica at the Gymnich meeting in Cyprus. Productive exchanges on deepening India-EU cooperation across priority areas.

posts.text: Structural reforms, productivity gains and technology adoption will continue driving India's growth. Budget 2026 focuses on Tier-II and Tier-III cities, semiconductor corridors, and fiscal discipline — balancing ambition with responsibility.
posts.caption: Structural reforms, productivity gains and technology adoption will continue driving India's growth. Budget 2026 focuses on Tier-II and Tier-III cities, semiconductor corridors, and fiscal discipline — balancing ambition with responsibility.

posts.text: Even in the face of fierce headwinds and relentless scrutiny — we have never retreated. We have recalibrated. We have reimagined. And we have become more formidable, more unbreakable, more resilient. Every challenge sharpens our resolve.
posts.caption: Even in the face of fierce headwinds and relentless scrutiny — we have never retreated. We have recalibrated. We have reimagined. And we have become more formidable, more unbreakable, more resilient. Every challenge sharpens our resolve.

posts.text: We are living through a once-in-a-generation transformation. Reliance was built for moments like these. We do not follow change — we build for it, ahead of it. From connecting India to empowering India, Jio is poised to lead India into the digital future.
posts.caption: We are living through a once-in-a-generation transformation. Reliance was built for moments like these. We do not follow change — we build for it, ahead of it. From connecting India to empowering India, Jio is poised to lead India into the digital future.

posts.text: I have always believed that the true measure of success is how much you give back to the community that helped you succeed. India's greatest strength is its people — their resilience, innovation and spirit.
posts.caption: I have always believed that the true measure of success is how much you give back to the community that helped you succeed. India's greatest strength is its people — their resilience, innovation and spirit.

posts.text: India's youth are the foundation of our democratic future. We must ensure every student has access to quality education and fair examinations. The nation stands with its young aspirants.
posts.caption: India's youth are the foundation of our democratic future. We must ensure every student has access to quality education and fair examinations. The nation stands with its young aspirants.

posts.text: Ships caught in the Strait due to our amazing and unprecedented Naval Blockade, which will now be lifted, may start the process of 'heading home!' Say HELLO to your wives, husbands, parents, and families from me, your favorite President!
posts.caption: Ships caught in the Strait due to our amazing and unprecedented Naval Blockade, which will now be lifted, may start the process of 'heading home!' Say HELLO to your wives, husbands, parents, and families from me, your favorite President!

posts.text: The Conservative Party must remain the party of enterprise, aspiration and opportunity. We need to rebuild trust with the British public through honesty and economic competence.
posts.caption: The Conservative Party must remain the party of enterprise, aspiration and opportunity. We need to rebuild trust with the British public through honesty and economic competence.

posts.text: The #1 factor that determines whether you achieve your goals is you. That's a premise of the American Dream and we will restore it. The government we elect is the government we deserve.
posts.caption: The #1 factor that determines whether you achieve your goals is you. That's a premise of the American Dream and we will restore it. The government we elect is the government we deserve.

posts.text: Proud to see so many Indian Americans contributing to public service at every level. Our diverse perspectives strengthen American democracy and governance.
posts.caption: Proud to see so many Indian Americans contributing to public service at every level. Our diverse perspectives strengthen American democracy and governance.

posts.text: Accountability and transparency are the cornerstones of good government. We're committed to ensuring the American people know the truth about what their government does.
posts.caption: Accountability and transparency are the cornerstones of good government. We're committed to ensuring the American people know the truth about what their government does.

posts.text: AI policy needs to balance innovation with responsibility. The US has an incredible opportunity to lead globally — and the Indian American tech community is at the forefront of making that happen.
posts.caption: AI policy needs to balance innovation with responsibility. The US has an incredible opportunity to lead globally — and the Indian American tech community is at the forefront of making that happen.

posts.text: The World Bank must evolve to meet the challenges of climate change, fragility and digital transformation. We're working to make development finance faster, more effective and more inclusive for every nation.
posts.caption: The World Bank must evolve to meet the challenges of climate change, fragility and digital transformation. We're working to make development finance faster, more effective and more inclusive for every nation.

posts.text: Our mission is clear: grow the economy, fix the NHS, and rebuild trust in politics. That means tough choices and honest conversations with the British people about the road ahead.
posts.caption: Our mission is clear: grow the economy, fix the NHS, and rebuild trust in politics. That means tough choices and honest conversations with the British people about the road ahead.

posts.text: Australia's future lies in the Indo-Pacific. We're deepening our partnerships with India, Japan and the Quad nations to ensure a free, open and prosperous region for all.
posts.caption: Australia's future lies in the Indo-Pacific. We're deepening our partnerships with India, Japan and the Quad nations to ensure a free, open and prosperous region for all.

posts.text: L'Europe doit investir massivement dans l'IA et la défense. We must build a stronger, more sovereign Europe — one that leads in technology, defense and diplomacy on the world stage.
posts.caption: L'Europe doit investir massivement dans l'IA et la défense. We must build a stronger, more sovereign Europe — one that leads in technology, defense and diplomacy on the world stage.

posts.text: The future belongs to those who prepare for it today. The UAE continues to invest in AI, space, and renewable energy — building the economy of tomorrow while serving the people of today.
posts.caption: The future belongs to those who prepare for it today. The UAE continues to invest in AI, space, and renewable energy — building the economy of tomorrow while serving the people of today.

posts.text: SpaceX has not committed to leasing Colossus for years, although it's possible that may be what happens. The short term was our request, not Anthropic's. We won't leave them hanging and will provide a reasonable off-ramp, but if compute gets super tight I said we might need it back at some point.
posts.caption: SpaceX has not committed to leasing Colossus for years, although it's possible that may be what happens. The short term was our request, not Anthropic's. We won't leave them hanging and will provide a reasonable off-ramp, but if compute gets super tight I said we might need it back at some point.

posts.text: Building AI that works for everyone is the defining challenge of our time. At Meta, we're focused on making AI open and accessible — the best ideas come when everyone can contribute.
posts.caption: Building AI that works for everyone is the defining challenge of our time. At Meta, we're focused on making AI open and accessible — the best ideas come when everyone can contribute.

posts.text: AI is the most profound technology we're working on today. Google is in an incredible position — from Gemini to Search to Cloud, we're bringing AI to billions of people and millions of developers worldwide.
posts.caption: AI is the most profound technology we're working on today. Google is in an incredible position — from Gemini to Search to Cloud, we're bringing AI to billions of people and millions of developers worldwide.

posts.text: 2026 is pivotal for AI. We've moved past discovery into widespread diffusion. We're beginning to distinguish between 'spectacle' and 'substance.' The real test now is adoption, reliability and value at scale — AI as scaffolding for human potential.
posts.caption: 2026 is pivotal for AI. We've moved past discovery into widespread diffusion. We're beginning to distinguish between 'spectacle' and 'substance.' The real test now is adoption, reliability and value at scale — AI as scaffolding for human potential.

posts.text: Heading to court this week. My schedule got taken away from me today, but the work at OpenAI continues. We're building the most important technology in human history and nothing changes that focus.
posts.caption: Heading to court this week. My schedule got taken away from me today, but the work at OpenAI continues. We're building the most important technology in human history and nothing changes that focus.

posts.text: There's no one on this planet I trust more to lead Apple into the future than John Ternus. I look forward to stepping into the role of Executive Chairman on September 1st. Incredibly optimistic about Apple's future.
posts.caption: There's no one on this planet I trust more to lead Apple into the future than John Ternus. I look forward to stepping into the role of Executive Chairman on September 1st. Incredibly optimistic about Apple's future.

posts.text: Taiwan is the epicenter of the AI revolution. This is where semiconductor chips, packaging and systems are made, and where AI supercomputers are born. Our annual investment in Taiwan will grow to as much as $150 billion. A new era of PC is coming.
posts.caption: Taiwan is the epicenter of the AI revolution. This is where semiconductor chips, packaging and systems are made, and where AI supercomputers are born. Our annual investment in Taiwan will grow to as much as $150 billion. A new era of PC is coming.

posts.text: India's digital public infrastructure — from Aadhaar to UPI — proves that technology built for scale and inclusion can transform a nation. AI must follow the same path: open, accessible and designed for India's billion-plus citizens.
posts.caption: India's digital public infrastructure — from Aadhaar to UPI — proves that technology built for scale and inclusion can transform a nation. AI must follow the same path: open, accessible and designed for India's billion-plus citizens.

posts.text: AI is going to be the most transformative technology of our lifetime. But the real impact won't come from the models themselves — it'll come from how we deploy them to solve problems in health, education and climate.
posts.caption: AI is going to be the most transformative technology of our lifetime. But the real impact won't come from the models themselves — it'll come from how we deploy them to solve problems in health, education and climate.

posts.text: Enterprise AI is moving from experimentation to deployment at scale. At IBM, we're focused on helping businesses operationalize AI responsibly — with trust, transparency and real ROI.
posts.caption: Enterprise AI is moving from experimentation to deployment at scale. At IBM, we're focused on helping businesses operationalize AI responsibly — with trust, transparency and real ROI.

posts.text: Creativity and AI are not at odds — they amplify each other. Adobe is building AI tools that empower creators, not replace them. The future of digital experiences is being shaped right now.
posts.caption: Creativity and AI are not at odds — they amplify each other. Adobe is building AI tools that empower creators, not replace them. The future of digital experiences is being shaped right now.

posts.text: Building technology that serves billions requires both bold vision and deep humility. The next wave of innovation will be defined by those who build responsibly and think long-term.
posts.caption: Building technology that serves billions requires both bold vision and deep humility. The next wave of innovation will be defined by those who build responsibly and think long-term.

posts.text: At Chanel, we believe in the power of human creativity — enhanced, not replaced, by technology. The future of luxury lies in authentic craftsmanship meeting innovation.
posts.caption: At Chanel, we believe in the power of human creativity — enhanced, not replaced, by technology. The future of luxury lies in authentic craftsmanship meeting innovation.

posts.text: Global trade is being reshaped by technology and geopolitics. At FedEx, we're leveraging AI and data analytics to build the most intelligent logistics network in the world.
posts.caption: Global trade is being reshaped by technology and geopolitics. At FedEx, we're leveraging AI and data analytics to build the most intelligent logistics network in the world.

posts.text: One more to go. IPL final tomorrow in Ahmedabad — the boys are ready. Scored 43 in the Qualifier but the team performance was outstanding. 254/5, 92-run win. Let's bring this home for RCB. 🏏
posts.caption: One more to go. IPL final tomorrow in Ahmedabad — the boys are ready. Scored 43 in the Qualifier but the team performance was outstanding. 254/5, 92-run win. Let's bring this home for RCB. 🏏

posts.text: Tough season for MI but proud of how the boys fought. Time to reflect, regroup and come back stronger. Wishing both teams the best for the IPL final tomorrow. Cricket is the real winner.
posts.caption: Tough season for MI but proud of how the boys fought. Time to reflect, regroup and come back stronger. Wishing both teams the best for the IPL final tomorrow. Cricket is the real winner.

posts.text: Best of luck to both teams for the IPL final. The beauty of T20 cricket is that anything can happen on any given day. Enjoy the game, Ahmedabad. 🏏💛
posts.caption: Best of luck to both teams for the IPL final. The beauty of T20 cricket is that anything can happen on any given day. Enjoy the game, Ahmedabad. 🏏💛

posts.text: Season didn't go as planned but I'm back to full fitness now. Managed a niggle through the T20 World Cup and needed time to recover. The work continues — always grateful for the support. 💙
posts.caption: Season didn't go as planned but I'm back to full fitness now. Managed a niggle through the T20 World Cup and needed time to recover. The work continues — always grateful for the support. 💙

posts.caption: All the best to both teams for the IPL final. It's been a rollercoaster season. Can't wait to watch a cracking game of cricket in Ahmedabad tomorrow! 🔥
